## Description

Leverages attention-based Temporal Fusion Transformers with static covariate encoders and variable selection networks to forecast multi-horizon volatility and asset returns.

## Where it may fit

Multi-horizon tactical asset allocation, volatility forecasting, macro-economic regime planning.

## Vehicles

Quantitative macro funds, systematic CTA funds, asset management research desks.

## Required data

Historical multivariate price series, static asset metadata, macroeconomic time-series features.

## Caveats

Requires significant GPU compute resources for training; attention mechanisms can overfit without proper regularization.
